obligations.text: A licensee, surplus line insurer, or reinsurer shall develop, implement, and maintain a program of administrative, technical, and physical safeguards sufficient to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of nonpublic information in the possession of the licensee, surplus line insurer, or reinsurer.
